newsitem.title: CHINA: China chemical fibre market begins to recover.
newsitem.headline: China chemical fibre market begins to recover.

text.p: China's chemical fibre market has started to recover since August due to policy support from Beijing after being in deep depression in the past year, the China Securities newspaper said on Friday.
Prices of some key chemical fibre products, including polyester, had increased by around 50 percent since late August, the newspaper said.

It said Beijing in recent months had helped to boost the market by offering 70 billion yuan in working capital to support the textile industry and allocating seven billion yuan to speed up the provision of export tax rebates to textile firms.
It said concerned government departments had predicted there would be a reduction in cotton output in China this year, further helping the price recovery of chemical fibre products.
"Prospects for the national chemical fibre market are very optimistic," the newspaper said.
